video_title: Dwyane Wade’s Miami Trip: Why You Need to Be "Selfish" to Succeed

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on why you must be selfish to be selfless
quotes.excerpt: You have to be selfish, everybody. You have to put your mask on first.
quotes.quote: We have this saying, and it's a word that was taught when we were young and it was taught in a negative way. It's a word called selfish. Selfish seems like it's negative, but for me, you have to be selfish, everybody. You have to put your mask on first. You have to take care of yourself first before you give and do for others. So we have a saying, our saying is, be selfish so you can be selfless.
quotes.social_post: Dwyane Wade shares his philosophy on leadership and personal growth: You have to be selfish so you can be selfless. Put your mask on first before you give to others.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on Erik Spoelstra's message to the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: He's just telling them today it's about getting 1% better.
quotes.quote: As basketball players, what Erik Spoelstra is telling the Miami Heat right now while they're on three and ready to see y'all ready to boot them, he's just telling them today it's about getting 1% better. You keep getting better each day, even if it's 1%, you've got better.
quotes.social_post: Dwyane Wade shares the message Erik Spoelstra is currently giving the Miami Heat: It is all about getting 1 percent better every single day.
